# PhillyVoice

> > Philadelphia's local news and culture source covering business, retail, real estate, lifestyle, and community stories across the Greater Philadelphia region.

PhillyVoice delivers hyperlocal news and features for Philadelphia and surrounding areas, with strong coverage of commercial development, retail openings, business deals, and lifestyle topics that matter to residents and visitors of the Delaware Valley.

## Key Topics

- Philadelphia business
- Center City development
- Retail and shopping
- Real estate and commercial property
- Gloucester Premium Outlets
- Liberty Property Trust
- Local news and community
- Regional partnerships
- Consumer services
- Philadelphia lifestyle
- Delaware Valley region
- Urban development
- Business acquisitions
